name: measurement-plan
title: Measurement plan for review
for_each: select id,code from projects order by code

sections.title: Purpose and accountability
sections.sql: select name,owner,purpose,review_on from projects where id=$1

sections.title: Tracking contract
sections.sql: select name,owner,purpose,required_properties,review_on from event_types where project_id=$1 order by name

sections.title: Funnel definitions
sections.sql: select code,name,steps,window_hours from funnels where project_id=$1 order by code
sections.note: Strict timestamp order. First observed entry per person in the selected range. No identity merging.

name: review-record
title: Product review and action register
for_each: select id,code from projects order by code

sections.title: Open questions
sections.sql: select reference,rule,finding,owner from review_attention where project_id=$1 order by rule,reference

sections.title: Decisions and evidence
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,due_on,status,evidence from actions where project_id=$1 order by due_on

sections.title: Changes recorded
sections.sql: select actor,operation,details,created_at from activity where project_id=$1 order by created_at
sections.note: Operational record, not a tamper-proof audit log. Draft for owner review.
